Thank you everyone who has been around for this past year, to all the new players who hopped on recently to the original group that know who Yumbo is. Slappyball hasn't made any giant splashes, but its thanks to the people sticking around its had its small little success on this corner of the internet.

Alright, enough sappy talk!

Get the [b]new birthday hat[/b] from the Daily Store before it disappears.

You can now pick the [b]number of points in a set[/b] for Custom Matches.

Reduced frequency of [b]matchmaking join[/b] issues.

There are [b]less shoe squeaks[/b] overall now, rejoice, the people who were getting really annoyed with that!

There are three ranks you can get with this Early Access build: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. There won't be bots or backfilling for this game mode. Play five matches to get your initial rank and work on climbing up to Gold. For now, there is only one rank shared between 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3.

[h2]Visual Upgrade[/h2]
Both the locker room and the UI have gotten an upgrade! This is a big step in looking more polished overall and we are so happy with the changes.

notes.title: Slappyball is under new management
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Slappyball is now being developed by a new team, Amelore. We are a small worker-owned game studio and we are so excited to bring this game to new heights. Here is a quick preview of everything we have in store for y'all:


[b]THE FIRST UPDATE ([i]Est. Later This Week[/i])[/b]

[b]Small performance update:[/b] frame rate limiting! Previously, it was unlimited and we have seen the complaints about high GPU usage even in menus.

[b]No more lootboxes:[/b] The lootbox has been removed for now, Team Names are given on every level up.

[b]New cosmetic:[/b] Tattoos will be added as a new cosmetic option to purchase.

[b]Analytics:[/b] Data to help us make major game design decisions.

[b]Logs:[/b] Phew, let's get some info from those crashes and see how we can fix them.

[i]Leaderboards Fix[/i]: This may not make it into the FIRST UPDATE but if not, we will try to squeeze in a small patch inbetween. 


[b]NEW QUEUES & BUG FIXES ([i]Est. Mid-Late August[/i])[/b]
[list]
[*] 1v1 and 2v2 queues
[*] Freeplay while matchmaking
[*] Stadium Ads
[*] First round of bug fixing
[/list]

[b]SEASON 0 UPDATE ([i]Est. September[/i])[/b]
[list]

notes.title: One Week Update!
notes.content:
[b]Version .17 Alpha[/b]
- Added a matchmaking player count to the find match button
- Added a ball depth meter at the top of the screen to help new players (can be turned off in options)
- Soft stopping while on the ground now locks your player in place while held
- Releasing set now does a "set hit" that can be used to set further horizontally (if timed correctly)
- Leaving matchmaking games early now gives a loss
- BUG FIX: Various individual leaderboard issues
- BUG FIX: Getting every random cosmetic from loot boxes will award coins now
- BUG FIX: Level 5 achievement not being awarded has been fixed
- BUG FIX: Teams should always been 3 v 3 in matchmaking (fixed 4 players on one team issue)
- BUG FIX: On-fire hits after a point is scored don't remove your on-fire state
